JVNDB-2026-000124
Zabbix agent may insecurely load Dynamic Link Libraries
Overview
Zabbix agent provided by Zabbix LLC may load Dynamic Link Libraries insecurely due to the following vulnerability.
Incorrect default permissions (CWE-276) - CVE-2026-59781
Kazuma Matsumoto of GMO Cybersecurity by IERAE, Inc. reported this vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.
